system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the eighth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
480 students were asked to name their favorite sport. The results are shown in this table.

| Sport | Number of Students |
| :--- | :--- |
| Hockey | 60 |
| Football | 180 |
| Tennis | 120 |
| Basketball | 120 |

Use the information in the table to complete and label this pie chart.

[Image: A circle with a point in the middle, and 8 equally spaced points on the circumference of the circle. The circle is labeled “Popularity of Sports.”]

Figure, described in words:
A circle labeled "Popularity of Sports" at the top. The circle contains a dot at its center and 8 equally spaced dots along its circumference, located at 12 o'clock, 1:30, 3 o'clock, 4:30, 6 o'clock, 7:30, 9 o'clock, and 10:30.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Compute each sport's share of 480 students and its angle: Hockey 60/480 = 1/8 = 12.5%, angle 45°; Football 180/480 = 3/8 = 37.5%, angle 135°; Tennis 120/480 = 1/4 = 25%, angle 90°; Basketball 120/480 = 1/4 = 25%, angle 90°. Check: 45 + 135 + 90 + 90 = 360°. To complete the pie chart, draw straight lines from the center dot to the circumference points as follows: starting at 12 o'clock, draw the first sector line from the center to the 12 o'clock point, then the line to the 1:30 point (45° sector) and label it Hockey (60 students, 1/8 of the circle). Next, from the 1:30 point to the 6 o'clock point (135° sector, spanning the 1:30, 3, 4:30 points), label that sector Football (180 students, 3/8 of the circle). Next, from the 6 o'clock point to the 9 o'clock point (90° sector, spanning 6, 7:30 points), label that sector Tennis (120 students, 1/4 of the circle). Finally, from the 9 o'clock point back to the 12 o'clock point (90° sector, spanning 9, 10:30 points), label that sector Basketball (120 students, 1/4 of the circle). Each sector is labeled with the sport name written inside it near the center, along with its count and fraction of the total.
